items.name: Hunting Hanger
items.description: A short, curved sword carried by gamekeepers and foot soldiers.

items.name: Highland Dirk
items.description: A long Scottish dagger. Fast, but you must get close.

items.name: Tomahawk
items.description: A light throwing axe traded along the colonial frontier.

items.name: Smallsword
items.description: The gentleman's thrusting blade of the century. Quick and precise.

items.name: Naval Cutlass
items.description: A broad, short blade for boarding actions and close quarters.

items.name: Cavalry Sabre
items.description: A curved, sweeping blade made for slashing from horseback.

items.name: Basket-hilted Broadsword
items.description: A heavy, double-edged Highland sword with a caged hilt.

items.name: Boarding Axe
items.description: A naval axe with a spike, for cutting rigging and skulls.

items.name: Spontoon
items.description: An officer's half-pike. Long reach keeps quick creatures at bay.

items.name: Sergeant's Halberd
items.description: Axe, hook and spear on one long staff. Still carried by sergeants.

items.name: Claymore Greatsword
items.description: An old two-handed greatsword. Only a trained, strong body can swing it.

items.name: Executioner's Sword
items.description: A broad, blunt-tipped greatsword built for one terrible blow.

items.name: Flintlock Pistol
items.description: One shot, then a long reload. Uses powder and shot.

items.name: Land Pattern Musket
items.description: The 'Brown Bess'. Fit with a bayonet, it is also a spear.

items.name: Blunderbuss
items.description: A flared muzzle that sprays shot. Devastating up close.

items.name: Pennsylvania Long Rifle
items.description: A rifled barrel that hits where you aim, at a painfully slow reload.

items.name: Rotfang Bone Cleaver
items.description: A strange, heavy cleaver of fused bone taken from a Brute.

items.name: Gnarling Hook-Knife
items.description: A barbed sickle-knife. Fast and cruel.

items.name: Ember Glaive
items.description: A blade that never cools, taken from the Foundry imps.
